svg.title: Forklift operator — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as forklift operator, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A side-view forklift has an open driver guard, seat, raised mast, projecting fork and two differently sized wheels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
